title: Body And Soul
tonality: Db major, with a bridge that starts in D
notes: AABA, 32 bars, and the one to check most carefully of the lot - no two charts agree on it. The bridge especially: it is written here as D major for four bars and then a chain of descending ii-Vs (Dm7 G7, Cm7 F7, Bbm7 Eb7, Ebm7 Ab7) back to Db. Many charts take a different route home, often through | Dbm7 Gb7 | or | Emaj7 |, and some write bars 17-20 as | D7 | G7 | Gmaj7 | ... Bar 3 | Dbmaj7 Gbm7 | is also written | Dbmaj7 Gb7 | or as a whole bar of Dbmaj7.
